facts: contains(name,exactTypeId) checks the exact stored tag type except that type99 accepts any numeric tag.
getByte and getInt accept numeric conversions; calling getInt alone does not establish that the schema tag was stored as an INT.
getCompound returns an empty compound for absent or wrongly typed data. Explicit contains(name,10) checks must therefore precede reading journal team compounds.
Journal validation should require an INT schema1 and BYTE value1 for each true proof instead of silently accepting converted, false or malformed values.
